The '''Tholian system''' was located in the [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Tholian]]s, a social group appearing in the play ''[[Jedi!]]'', which was [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Palleus Chuff]]<ref name="Yoda">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> at some point by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', during which ''[[Jedi!]]'' is mentioned, to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tholian [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-4.<ref name="TEA" />
